meta.title: Ledger domain layer
meta.description: Display page for this Beancount ledger inside DSH. Aliases, reconciliation periods, the draft queue and validated atomic writes all live in the separate Python core library ledger-domain-core; this plugin only authenticates the browser session, forwards each request as `python -m ledger_domain`, and renders the JSON. No domain logic and no agent tools. First run provisions the local engine and creates the ledger in the panel, and the review tab can record a manual entry.
